newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March EU harmonised CPI 2.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy March EU harmonised CPI 2.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian EU-harmonised consumer price inflation rose 2.2 percent year-on-year and 0.2 percent month-on-month in March, the national statistics institute ISTAT said on Tuesday.
It gave no percentage comparisons but said in a table that the index, base 1996, stood at 101.5 in March, up from 101.3 in February and from 99.3 in March 1996.
ISTAT released the figures with regular consumer price data for April.
